story.label: Opening
story.value: Heat shimmers above the stone flats. Caravans gather where the last shade reaches the well.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: The request
story.value: Branora brings the work to the party through Thraxis Arena Masters. Branora is tracking an outlaw, monster or rival who has fled into the wilds.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Ruins of the Sundered Usurper. Examine the salvaged ledger recording the trade route. Examine the overgrown muster book recording the trade route. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The request has become a public test of the faction’s promises. Completing the objectives supplies a concrete result; abandoning them sends the dispute back to the assembly.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

monster.name: Camel Silver
traits: Blinding Spit. replaces the attack action; once per fight. Trigger: An enemy approaches its head. Range: near. Make the existing spit attack (+0, 1d4 damage). On a hit, the target has disadvantage on attacks and sight-based checks until the end of the camel's next turn. This replaces the whole attack routine; no hoof attack is also made. Telegraph: It pulls back its lips and works its jaw while staring at the target. Behaviour: Use against the nearest approaching enemy within near; choose randomly on ties.
